note: An index into docs/DECISION-*.md, not a second record. The document is authoritative; every string here except rejected[].alternative must appear verbatim in the document it is attributed to, and tests/test_decision_graph.py fails otherwise. Questions are not stored here: they are derived from docs/research_question_registry.json.

statuses.ADOPTED: in force; the document records it as implemented or effective
statuses.WITHDRAWN: reversed by its own record; kept because a correction is part of the record
statuses.PENDING: decided and not in force; the document says so

decisions.status_quote: The Tier-1 pre-flight is re-based on a witness the arm is alive at
chosen: G1's witness is the per-cycle trace on a design the arm is alive at, not a terminal snapshot.
The Tier-1 campaign may not launch until a persistence pre-flight on its own stimulus shows the reference arm alive at the campaign horizon.
The matched-frequency persistence repair is promoted into the engine on 2026-11-10.

Each sleep cycle maintains a per-tag denominator `D = 0.95 * D_previous + delta`, where `delta` is the increase in `MemoryService.tag_frequencies()` since the previous cycle; prediction strength divides the temporal count by `max(D, 1)`.
The temporal decay constant, death threshold, stable threshold, candidate decay, admission floor, caps, retention policy and candidate set are unchanged.

rejected.alternative: Keep the 40-cycle L1 snapshot and lower the probe to 35 cycles
rejected.reason: It moves the witness to a cliff edge and passes only because the collapse is three cycles later, so the next unrelated change re-breaks it.

rejected.alternative: Run the Tier-1 matrix and drop the early cycles afterwards
rejected.reason: Selecting the window after seeing the result is the defect the preregistration exists to prevent.

rejected.alternative: Change the decay rule so the reference arm survives
rejected.reason: It is a cognition change with no preregistration, and it would make the run measure the fix rather than the engine.

rejected.alternative: Keep the repair in process only
rejected.reason: It would leave D2's gate measured on an engine that is not the one the campaign would run.

rejected.alternative: Promote without a version bump and re-pin
rejected.reason: The pin would stop describing the engine, and AGENTS.md rule 12 would record the change as unrecorded bytes.
